Recalibrates the whole punch list — Tier 1 is now about being citable, not being #1. GBP photos untouched 30+ days flagged as stale. Reinforces items #13, #16. gaps.title: No blog / editorial content
gaps.why: Freshness cliff at ~3 months. Confirmed hard by 2026-07-12 Discovered Labs / MarketingCode study: median time from publish to first ChatGPT/Claude citation is 6.81 days; 75% of cited pages are indexed-then-cited within 18.7 days. Perplexity shows even stronger recency bias, displacing higher-authority incumbents with pages updated in the last few weeks. April-2026 industry data: 76.4% of ChatGPT's top-cited pages were updated within 30 days, 50% of Perplexity citations come from content less than 13 weeks old. osteopath-christchurch.com is winning headache/migraine/cranial/baby-osteo queries on blog-post velocity — 1 short post per condition is enough to claim those niches. MK Osteopathy is doing the same for TMJ. Ahrefs schema study (Aug 2025–Mar 2026) also confirms: adding schema produced NO major uplift in AI citations — content depth + freshness are what compound. PR #108 (Practitioner Spotlight) is the first fresh editorial slot on the site but is a one-off, not a Decap collection with sustained cadence. The case for a proper blog is now the strongest it has been since the audit started.

gaps.title: No off-site citation strategy
gaps.why: Reddit appears in 46.5% of Perplexity citations (stable as of week of 2026-07-17) and ~5% of ChatGPT citations. Reddit is the second most visible website in Google search results in 2026 (only Wikipedia ahead) and is now the most-cited social domain across AI models. Tinuiti Q1 2026 data: social-media share of AI citations climbed past 9% Oct-2025 → Jan-2026, with Reddit accounting for the dominant share of that growth across nine product categories. ClaudeBot crawl volume grew 800% at the start of 2026 as Anthropic scaled its web search API — Reddit citations are increasingly the path into Claude's answers too. Semrush 2026-07-13 126M-prompt Index further shows that health/local isn't as concentrated as News/CE — a small clinic can still crack the top brand set with sustained mentions across social + review + editorial surfaces. Item #15 still applies.

gaps.title: No proprietary NZ clinic caseload / statistics content
gaps.why: New this run 2026-07-17. Multiple 2026-07 analyses argue original / proprietary data (case counts, patient-mix statistics, first-person NZ figures) is now the highest-ROI AI-citation asset — models cite original stats + sample sizes more readily than restated advice. Meridian has a natural moat here as no other Christchurch clinic publishes anonymised caseload figures, and NZ-specific stats have no direct incumbent. Drives new item #36.

items.title: Add speakable blocks on service intros
items.body: Add schema.org speakable specification on service intro paragraphs for voice assistants / Gemini Live. With the citation-ready 40–60 word answers now in place (item #31 shipped 2026-05-17), wrapping them in a speakable block is the natural follow-up — gives voice assistants a single span to read aloud rather than guessing. NOTE 2026-06-05: Ahrefs schema-study (week-of-2026-05) found adding JSON-LD produced no major uplift in AI citations — reinforced by Ahrefs Q2 2026 update (2026-07-15) showing top-10 organic share of AIO citations fell 76% → 38% while format (listicle/answer-first) accounts for 52% of AI mentions. So this remains a low-impact-but-still-cheap item; do not over-prioritise relative to items #14, #34, #36.

items.title: Auto-fetch Google Business Profile reviews at build time
items.body: So reviewCount / ratingValue stay current without manual edits. Build script hits Places API with a 24h cache. Reinforced 2026-06-05 by local-SEO data showing reviews older than 18 months 'carry diminishing weight' for AI citation confidence. Reinforced again 2026-07-17 by Canvas Score / GMB Mantra commentary framing review recency as a 'proof of life' tie-breaker — a clinic with 80 reviews steady over 30 days now outranks one with 200 where the last is 8 months old. GBP is still the primary data source for AI-driven local search per May-2026 PinMeTo / MedRankSEO data and Google is replacing Maps Q&A with Gemini-generated answers pulled from GBP + reviews + the clinic website. Combined with #16 (encourage monthly reviews) and #37 (visible reviewed-by byline), this closes the freshness loop end to end.

items.title: Start a blog (2 posts/month)
items.body: Short evidence-based articles per condition. Each post: author byline with Physician schema, datePublished, dateModified, 3–5 FAQs. Ahrefs analysis of 17M AI citations (April 2026) found AI-cited content is 25.7% fresher than traditional Google organic results — 76.4% of ChatGPT's top-cited pages were updated within the last 30 days. Freshness compounds. STRONGEST CASE YET 2026-07-17 from Discovered Labs / MarketingCode: median time from publish to first ChatGPT/Claude citation is 6.81 days; 75% of cited pages are indexed-then-cited within 18.7 days. Perplexity shows even stronger recency bias, displacing higher-authority incumbents with pages updated in the last few weeks. Confirmed again 2026-06-05: osteopath-christchurch.com still owns headaches/cranial/baby/teeth-grinding/stress/arthritis queries on the strength of one short blog post per condition; MK Osteopathy still owns the TMJ slot the same way. Ahrefs schema-impact study (Aug 2025–Mar 2026): adding schema produced NO major uplift in AI citations — removing schema as a competing investment lever, content depth + freshness are doing the work. With /admin CMS coverage now filled (PR #91), the editorial path is shorter than it was — adding a Decap blog collection would let the clinic publish without code changes. PR #108 (Practitioner Spotlight) proves the editorial workflow, but a one-off is not a blog; a sustained 2-post/month cadence is what earns the 6.81-day citation window.

items.title: Seed Reddit / community brand mentions
items.body: Genuine, non-spammy answers on r/newzealand / r/chch / r/AskNZ threads about osteopathy, ACC claims, back pain. Reddit is 46.5% of Perplexity citations (stable week of 2026-07-17) and ~5% of ChatGPT citations, and the second most visible site in Google results overall (Wikipedia first). Tinuiti Q1 2026 data: social-media share of AI citations climbed past 9% Oct-2025 → Jan-2026 with Reddit accounting for the dominant share of that growth. Conductor research note: when LLMs do cite Reddit, sole-source citations rose 31% — Reddit is increasingly the only source for a given answer. ClaudeBot scaled 800% at start of 2026 — Reddit is increasingly the path into Claude's answers too. Semrush 2026-07-13 126M-prompt Index shows health/local is less concentrated than other verticals (top-3 brands hold 41–83%), so a small clinic can still crack the top set with sustained Reddit + editorial + review presence. 90/10 rule: 90% non-promotional, 2–4 weeks of karma-building before any mention of Meridian.

items.title: Encourage monthly Google reviews nudge
items.body: Post-consultation email nudge via Resend (already wired). AI engines prefer reviews under 12 months old. Reinforced 2026-05-02: Google's March 2026 core update now weights review recency AND owner response rate more heavily than raw count. Healthcare best-practice = at least 1 new review/week. May-2026 PinMeTo data: GBP is the primary data source for AI-driven local search across Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT and Perplexity location queries. Reinforced 2026-06-05: local-SEO data confirms 'reviews older than 18 months carry diminishing weight' for AI citation confidence, and content/signals updated within the past two months earn 28% more AI citations than older material. Reinforced 2026-07-17 by Canvas Score / GMB Mantra framing review recency as 'proof of life' tie-breaker — a clinic with 80 reviews steady over 30 days outranks one with 200 where the last is 8 months old. Combined with #13 (auto-fetch reviews at build time) and #37 (visible reviewed-by byline), this closes the GBP review-recency loop end to end.

items.title: Enable Google Search Console Generative AI performance report + baseline first two weeks
items.body: Google launched a dedicated Generative AI performance report in Search Console on 2026-06-03 that tracks impressions for AI Overviews and AI Mode, broken down by pages, countries, devices and dates at hourly through monthly granularity. The opt-out toggle took effect 2026-06-17 — sites were opted IN by default until then, after which an admin can disable AI-surface reporting. Search Engine Roundtable confirmed 2026-07-09 that rollout expanded to more properties. This is the first first-party way to measure AI-search visibility for meridianosteopathy.co.nz (citation overlap with the organic top-10 collapsed to 17–38% post-Gemini-3 and further to 38% per Ahrefs Q2 2026 update, so traditional rank tracking now misses the majority of the AI-surface story). Action items: (1) verify the clinic's GSC account has meridianosteopathy.co.nz as a verified property, (2) confirm the AI Overviews / AI Mode toggle is left ON (default), (3) screenshot the first two weeks of baseline data to bank a 'pre-blog' reading before item #14 ships. No code changes needed. Reinforced by Search Engine Journal week-of-2026-05: Google's AI search guide officially treats AEO and GEO as part of SEO, so the GSC report is intended to be the canonical measurement surface. GSC report STILL does not include clicks as of 2026-07-17 — impressions-only for now.

items.title: Publish an annual anonymised NZ clinic caseload snapshot
items.body: New this run 2026-07-17. Multiple 2026-07 analyses (Search Engine Land 2026-07-11 argument on proprietary data as AI-citation asset; MarketingCode 2026-07-12 study; Ahrefs Q2 2026 citation update 2026-07-15) converge on the same point: proprietary / original data (case counts, patient-mix statistics, first-person NZ figures) is now the highest-ROI AI-citation asset — models cite original stats + sample sizes more readily than restated advice. Meridian has a natural moat here as no other Christchurch clinic publishes anonymised caseload figures, and NZ-specific figures have no direct incumbent. Draft a short page (300–500 words) with 8–12 anonymised statistics from the clinic's Cliniko records: e.g. 'X% of new osteopathy patients in the last 12 months presented with lower-back pain', '% of appointments funded under ACC', 'top 5 presenting conditions by month', 'average time from first appointment to discharge for whiplash cases'. Wrap in Dataset + MedicalStudy schema; link from footer + About page. Update annually. Coordinates with items #14 (blog freshness) and #37 (reviewed-by byline). Addresses G25.

items.title: Add visible 'Reviewed [date] by [practitioner]' byline to service + condition pages
items.body: New this run 2026-07-17. Doubles as freshness signal AND E-E-A-T author signal in one edit.
